verdict.rationale: Sentry's Alerts feature supports rule-based routing to Slack, webhooks, tickets and other integrations (sentry-docs-21, sentry-docs-3, sentry-intdir-1), and it can ingest broad telemetry via OTLP traces/logs plus issues/performance data (sentry-docs-8, sentry-docs-9, sentry-docs-36), giving an SRE multi-signal alerting with routing. However, there is no explicit documentation of alert grouping/deduplication rules or silencing/snoozing/muting of notifications, so the story's grouping and silencing requirements are unevidenced. Missing for 10: explicit alert grouping/deduplication configuration, snooze/mute/silence controls for notifications, and confirmation that arbitrary telemetry (not just errors/traces) can trigger alerts.
